prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) but poor seasonality (-0.1956), while ONLY_CWT_rf leads in seasonality capture (0.3414) with moderate trend tracking. DWT_catboost dominates overall RMSE (71.55) and both horizons, making it the clear overall champion. High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 22.6) and seasonality variance suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit complementary strengths across decomposition components.
